import numpy as np
Tb={'1':np.ones_like(t),'t':t,'t2':t**2,'sqrt':np.sqrt(t),'sin':np.sin(t),'cos':np.cos(t),'1/t':1/t}
Sb={'1':np.ones_like(v),'v':v,'v|v|':v*np.abs(v),'x':x,'x2':x**2,'1/x':1/x,'xv':x*v}
cols=[];names=[]
for a,ta in Tb.items():
    for b,sb in Sb.items():
        cols.append(ta*sb); names.append(a+'*'+b)
B=np.array(cols).T
c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)
print('prod basis NMSE',np.mean((B@c-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
# greedy backward elimination
keep=list(range(B.shape[1]))
while len(keep)>1:
    errs=[]
    for k in keep:
        kk=[q for q in keep if q!=k]
        cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B[:,kk],dv_dt,rcond=None)
        errs.append((np.mean((B[:,kk]@cc-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt),k))
    e,k=min(errs)
    keep.remove(k)
    if e>5e-3: break
    last=(e,list(keep))
print('kept',[names[k] for k in last[1]],last[0])
cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B[:,last[1]],dv_dt,rcond=None)
print(np.round(cc,4))
